vetSays.line: 🛡️ Henry, Jenny, Ingrid and Saad met them at the door — 4 put down. Henry, Jenny, Ingrid, Saad are hurt.
🛡️ Henry, Jenny and Ingrid met them at the door — 3 put down. Henry, Jenny, Ingrid are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Henry just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Henry, Jenny and Ingrid met them at the door — 3 put down. Henry, Jenny, Ingrid are hurt.
★ IDENTIFIED: European Elder. Elder. Big shrub; flat white flower plates in June, drooping black berry clusters in late summer. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
Nathan was watching. Now they know European Elder too.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: European Elder — named and noted.
Ethan showed Sam the European Elder — "remember it." Word gets around.
Nathan showed Zihao the European Elder — "remember it." The haven hears about it by supper.
Zihao showed Saad the European Elder — "remember it." Word travels before the lesson cools.
Jesse showed Henry the European Elder — "remember it." The haven hears about it by supper.
Elijah showed Meera the European Elder — "remember it." Word travels before the lesson cools.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Henry just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Luis, Nathan and Meera met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Luis, Nathan, Meera are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Jesse just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Saad just put down The Big Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Saad, Zihao, Luis and Nathan met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 barely walked away. Zihao, Nathan are hurt.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
🛡️ Giulia and Enrique met them at the door — 2 put down. Giulia, Enrique are hurt.
🛡️ Giulia, Gopal and Jorge met them at the door — 1 put down, 2 barely walked away. Giulia, Gopal, Jorge are hurt.

📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Gopal just put down Loud-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
